body:
Ouch, that's a really good catch. Thanks for reporting it!

In the long term we'd like to get rid of the shell script launcher in favor of a native c++ one instead, which would fix this problem Once And For All<sup>TM</sup>. See also https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/2218.
